metadata.verification: Static source extraction only. Application JavaScript was parsed, never executed; no business endpoint was called.
metadata.schemaScope: Frontend defaults and validation rules, not authoritative server schemas, requiredness or access rights.

methodology: Consumed Acorn declaration/function index of the full public bundle.
Parsed selected initializer expressions only; no application code was executed.
Enum inventory includes named top-level object constants or compiled enum IIFEs containing literal CODE:CATEGORY server-style values.
Template inventory preserves exact default structures and references, excluding the editor toolbar/base-format constants.
Yup inventory includes named global and local direct schema builders and factories; chained method order, arguments and conditions are preserved.
Inline form validationSchema props are separately structured when directly built with Yup.
Custom Yup extensions are parsed from addMethod calls, without executing definitions.
Associations require validationSchema and initialValues in the same parsed props object.
DTO inventory separates observed string literals, discriminator maps, type-guard predicates, and template type fields.
No value inferred from a UI default or UI validator is labelled a server requirement.
limitations: Dynamic schemas created from server-provided metadata, code-list values returned by APIs and runtime feature choices are not recoverable statically.
Aliased/computed objects are preserved as references or expressions rather than executed.
Anonymous validators outside identifiable form-prop objects are not separately inventoried.
Enum inventory is scoped to CODE:CATEGORY code-bearing constants; untagged application enums and vendor/library enums are outside this file, except selected DTO discriminator maps.
The inventory is specific to the fetched hashed main bundle; additional app assets require a separate pass.
